lane: fresh independent source review; no native/browser acceptance

verdict_a.source: PARTIAL: the owned-reload positive path and post-acceptance replacement guard are source-tested; pre-first-commit same-URL external navigation is not causally excluded
verdict_a.native: UNVERIFIED: the frozen 0.2.325 receipt lacks the worker terminal and panel result; no installed-browser check of this source was run
evidence: A nonce-bound MAIN-world probe yields a Chrome documentId from the accepted new execution context; close returns that ID only if the context was not replaced. The worker compares it with the current top frame, and both saved UIs compare it with the active-tab snapshot before showing rows.

The same capture core sets documentContext from the first new default main-frame context after reloadIssued and commits the first matching-URL Page.frameNavigated. It does not distinguish the reload command's navigation from a user-initiated same-URL navigation that supplants it before first commit. The nonce proves which document was captured, not why that document navigated.

The new unrelated same-route test creates context 3 only after context 2, its response, and the first frame commit. It proves post-acceptance replacement rejection, not the pre-commit substitution case.

verdict_b.quality: FAIL / IMPORTANT: navigation ownership is inferred from timing and URL, so an unrelated same-URL document can be attested and accepted if it is the first committed document after Page.reload. This is a source-supported race hypothesis requiring a forcing regression and causal gate before the source can be trusted.
verdict_b.test_gap: Add a controlled case where Page.reload is requested, then an independent same-URL top-frame navigation replaces it before the first new document commits; let that later document emit a valid hook nonce and matching response. The terminal result, current row, Last run, and saved history must all reject that external navigation. Keep the existing positive owned reload and post-commit replacement cases as controls.
verdict_b.duplication: PatternsTab and DataView separately implement the same replayOwner/isCurrent guard. No behavioral divergence was found in this diff, but the ownership policy should have one shared source before expanding its cases.
verdict_b.red_proof: The builder's original-behavior current-row RED was an unguarded diagnostic; its guarded RED covered only the exact Last run label. I did not count either as an independent guarded mutation of old invalidation.
